say:2:1741123002:1.text: Ever since I promised to stop interfering with Gwyneth's work, that girl's been running herself ragged.
say:2:1741123002:1.source_cn: 自从我答应不再干涉格温妮丝的工作后，这孩子……简直就像...
say:2:1741123002:1.male: Ever since I promised to stop interfering with Gwyneth's work, that girl's been running herself ragged.
say:2:1741123002:1.female: Ever since I promised to stop interfering with Gwyneth's work, that girl's been running herself ragged.

say:3:1741123003:1.text: I used to worry she didn't have enough real experience. Now I'm worried she's going to run herself into the ground. She signed up for the toughest night patrols and doubled her training.
say:3:1741123003:1.source_cn: 以前我担心她历练得太少，现在我更担心她把自己累垮了。她...
say:3:1741123003:1.male: I used to worry she didn't have enough real experience. Now I'm worried she's going to run herself into the ground. She signed up for the toughest night patrols and doubled her training.
say:3:1741123003:1.female: I used to worry she didn't have enough real experience. Now I'm worried she's going to run herself into the ground. She signed up for the toughest night patrols and doubled her training.

say:4:1741123004:1.text: Last night, I went to inspect the base and found her still practicing archery. I told her to get some rest, but she said she was finally living like a real knight...
say:4:1741123004:1.source_cn: 昨天半夜我去驻地查哨，发现她还在练箭，我劝她休息，她却...
say:4:1741123004:1.male: Last night, I went to inspect the base and found her still practicing archery. I told her to get some rest, but she said she was finally living like a real knight...
say:4:1741123004:1.female: Last night, I went to inspect the base and found her still practicing archery. I told her to get some rest, but she said she was finally living like a real knight...

say:5:1741123005:1.text: I suppose that's on me... I held her back for too long.
say:5:1741123005:1.source_cn: 也怪我……是我之前让她憋得太狠了。
say:5:1741123005:1.male: I suppose that's on me... I held her back for too long.
say:5:1741123005:1.female: I suppose that's on me... I held her back for too long.

say:6:1741123006:1.text: Magister Merlin, when you have a chance, could you talk to her too? Her work matters, but so does her health.
say:6:1741123006:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，要是方便的话，你也帮我劝劝她。工作固然重要，...

say:6:1741123006:1.female: Magister Merlin, when you have a chance, could you talk to her too? Her work matters, but so does her health.

say:7:1741123007:1.text: After all... she's the future of the Lightbearers now.
